title: Billing Payment Processing Delays
customerImpact: Payment attempts took up to 6 minutes to confirm. No charges were duplicated; invoices continued to generate correctly.
investigation: Payment confirmation webhooks from the processor were being delayed, stalling the billing reconcile loop.
rootCause: The payment processor experienced a regional webhook backlog. Our reconcile loop serialized on the delayed webhook queue.
mitigation: Switched reconcile to poll the processor API directly until webhooks caught up.
resolution: Webhook backlog cleared; reconcile back on webhooks. No financial impact.

updates.author: Danilo Okafor, SRE
updates.details: Processor webhook backlog stalling the reconcile loop. Switching to polling fallback.

updates.author: Danilo Okafor, SRE
updates.details: Payments confirmed, no duplicated charges, reconcile restored.
